verdict.rationale: Intel provides official SDKs that target this chip: oneAPI with oneDNN and PyTorch optimizations aimed specifically at Core Ultra Series 2, VTune Profiler support for its GPU and NPU, SYCL interoperability, and the OpenVINO toolkit with a documented NPU inference device. The evidence is first-party only, and most items are marketing summaries rather than in-depth API documentation. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of building on these SDKs with the 258V, detailed SDK reference/API documentation evidence, explicit SKU-level (258V) NPU support confirmation.
